external_entities.name: Member
external_entities.description: A person who uses the grocery loyalty programme, collects points, and spends them on gift cards.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members collect points when they shop and spend them on gift cards.

external_entities.name: Member device
external_entities.description: A member's phone used to run the mobile app and retain its refresh token.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The app keeps a refresh token on the phone.

external_entities.name: Partner company
external_entities.description: A company that runs a partner app on its own servers.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers

external_entities.name: Browser
external_entities.description: A browser used by a member to sign in and approve a partner app connection.
external_entities.source_excerpt: A member who connects a partner app signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser

processes.name: Mobile app
processes.description: The mobile application used by members to sign in and call the rewards API.
processes.notes: The text does not state the app's technology.

processes.name: Authorization server
processes.description: The server that authenticates members, handles authorization code flows, issues tokens, and manages partner consents.
processes.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow

processes.name: Rewards API
processes.description: The API called by the mobile app and partner apps to access loyalty points and the points ledger.
processes.source_excerpt: then calls the rewards API with the access token it gets back

processes.name: Partner app
processes.description: A web application operated by another company, such as a meal-planning service that shows a member's points.
processes.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers
processes.notes: Each partner app receives a client ID and client secret.

processes.name: Support console
processes.description: A web application that closes a member's account.
processes.source_excerpt: The support console is a web app that closes a member's account.

data_stores.name: Identity database
data_stores.description: The database containing member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database

data_stores.name: Points ledger
data_stores.description: The ledger containing every member's balance and every points transaction.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the points ledger, which holds every member's balance and every points transaction

data_stores.name: API log store
data_stores.description: The store containing every request received by the rewards API, including headers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: The mobile app signs a member in through the authorization server using the authorization code flow.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow
data_flows.notes: The source says it is unknown whether the app sends a PKCE challenge.
data_flows.data_description: Member sign-in request and authorization data

data_flows.name: disconnect app
data_flows.description: The mobile app requests that a member disconnect a partner app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members can disconnect a partner app from the settings screen of the mobile app

data_flows.name: call API
data_flows.description: The mobile app calls the rewards API using an access token.
data_flows.source_excerpt: then calls the rewards API with the access token it gets back
data_flows.notes: The access token is a plain bearer token.
data_flows.data_description: Rewards API requests using an access token

data_flows.name: request tokens
data_flows.description: A partner app sends token requests containing its client secret.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The partner app sends that secret in the body of its token requests.

data_flows.name: show points
data_flows.description: A partner app calls the rewards API to show a member's points.
data_flows.source_excerpt: such as a meal-planning service that shows a member's points

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A member's browser sends sign-in and consent interactions to the authorization server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: A member who connects a partner app signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser

data_flows.name: return code
data_flows.description: The browser returns an authorization code to the partner app's redirect URI.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The browser then returns to the partner app's redirect URI with an authorization code.

data_flows.name: manage identity
data_flows.description: The authorization server stores and manages member identity, authorization, token, and consent data.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database
data_flows.data_description: Member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents

data_flows.name: read and write ledger
data_flows.description: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger, including balances and points transactions.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger

data_flows.name: write logs
data_flows.description: The rewards API writes every received request and its headers to the API log store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

data_flows.name: download key
data_flows.description: The rewards API downloads a public key from the authorization server when it starts.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API checks the signature with a public key it downloads when it starts.

data_flows.name: use tokens
data_flows.description: The support console uses access tokens issued by the authorization server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It takes access tokens from the same authorization server

data_flows.name: close account
data_flows.description: The support console marks a member's account closed in the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Closing an account marks it closed in the identity database.
data_flows.notes: The member's refresh tokens remain in the database.

trust_boundaries.name: Our cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud account controlled by the loyalty platform operator, where the described platform components and stores run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Everything below runs in our own cloud account

trust_boundaries.name: Member devices
trust_boundaries.description: The zone containing members' phones, which are outside the platform operator's control.

trust_boundaries.name: Partner servers
trust_boundaries.description: The zone containing servers operated by other companies for their partner apps.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers

assumptions.assumption: The identity database's stated member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents are confidential.
assumptions.basis: The store contains personal information, credentials, and token or consent data.

assumptions.assumption: The points ledger's member balances and points transactions are confidential.
assumptions.basis: The store contains member-specific loyalty balances and transaction records.
